purpose: minimal additive extension for ground-derived coordinates; draft only, requires Codex review before GL-02 implements
constraints: does not change HF-01 health/manifest v1 (schema_version=1)
does not change frozen semantics of existing fields; only additive optional fields
ground-derived transform is stored separately from measured extrinsics and is never written into T_reference_lidar / R_lidar_imu
presence of a ground block never implies a verified world/vehicle pose

additive_block.ground_id: stable id/hash of ground params + ROI + source data hash

ground_transform.R: 3x3 finite orthonormal det=+1, rows = [u, v, n]
ground_transform.x_reference_axis_source: confirmed source reference axis used for u (default source +X), recorded explicitly
ground_transform.convention_note: horizontal origin/heading are conventions, not measurements; tilted floor normal != gravity

additive_block.valid_region_ground_local: ROI bounds and point count, for coverage checks
additive_block.source: bag/numeric file name + sha256 + frame group selection (unchanged by this extension)

per_candidate_additive_fields.center_ground_m: [x,y,z] or null; center of the same actual candidate points transformed by ground R/t
per_candidate_additive_fields.bbox_ground_from: actual_points | unavailable (never computed from only the source min/max two corners)

coordinate_additions.horizontal_basis: ground_tangent (existing) when a valid ground artifact is loaded

C_frontend_same_version_consumption: render ground mode only when snapshot.calibration.calibration_id/version matches the loaded ground artifact
if physical_verified=false, label the view as unverified/preview; never show as calibrated world coordinates
missing/unknown/newer fields -> ignore and fall back to source view; never default to valid/green
two-dimensional selection rectangle is generated from the same ground AABB eight corners; selection still sends original snapshot_id/candidate_id, not pixels
D_legacy_and_compatibility: all new fields optional; old clients keep working on source fields
new fields do not rename or repurpose reference_frame/reference_* (may be null)
schema_version is bumped only if a frozen field's meaning/enum changes, not for additive optional fields
v1 records without the new fields load with ground mode disabled and physical flags false
E_recalibration_invalidation: a new ground_id/calibration_version invalidates old snapshots, positions, and standing-baseline eligibility
source seq/stamp_secs/stamp_nsecs/time_epoch sources are preserved and compared unchanged

monitoring: only regions with trusted ground support are residual-checked; insufficient support -> unknown/degraded; sustained change -> require recalibration (no claim of full yaw/horizontal drift detection)
